en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2147 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever visits this House, either for Hajj or Umrah, free from arrogance, returns from their sins as pure as the day their mother gave birth to them. Arrogance is to deny the truth and to attack its people, and whoever does so has contested Allah (swt) for His mantle."
